reviews.text:
I've been a client of this clinic for many years. And I want to thank this wonderful team of professionals for their care of my dog, whom I've taken to the emergency room many times, and they've saved her life. They've taken such good care of her. 🙏
A special thank you to Almudena, an angel, a true professional and a wonderful person, with so much empathy. I thank her from the bottom of my heart, and so does my dog. 🐶💖🙏
Thank you for everything. Thank you 😇

Hello, after reading the opinions, which are all respectable, my experience at the clinic has been good. I took in a mastiff with a piece of a ball lodged in his small intestine, and they resolved it successfully. Another dog with leishmaniasis from three years ago is still alive, and so on. The prices for all these procedures are a bit high, though, but that's the case at all veterinary clinics. Thank you.

They've ruined a whole year of preparations for my trip: a trip I was so excited about (flights, hotels, transportation, etc.). I chose this veterinary hospital to get my cat vaccinated, tested, and get his passport, etc., for our trip to Japan. They told me not to worry, that they would take care of everything. They charged me almost €700, and today, when I was supposed to fly to Japan, I'm stuck at home with all my savings gone because of the incompetence of the staff at this hospital. They've ruined me. And if I want to go to Japan with my cat, I can't for another six months. And the worst part is, they haven't even offered me an apology.

A few days ago I took my dog ​​to a dermatology appointment and I was delighted with both the treatment from the clinic team and Irene's excellent work. I thought she was a great professional who knows what she's doing and of course she will continue treating my dog.
Great professionals, always ready to take care of our pets' health

My pet is treated by Almudena and Marta, who are fantastic professionals. I've been going to them for six years, and they take wonderful care of my pet and are always right about his health. Highly recommended.

Terrible!!!
I took my dog ​​to their doggy daycare where he was bitten as soon as he walked in. When they took him to this vet (who's affiliated with Campingdog daycare), they told me they'd done a lot of things: staples, a 48-hour antibiotic, laser treatment for the wound...
When I picked him up and the poorly applied bandage came off, I was shocked. He had a staple incorrectly placed and the wound was completely open.
My dog ​​was in terrible shape, and that night I had to take him to the emergency vet where he had to have emergency surgery. The bite, which they supposedly treated, was necrotic and very infected. So much so that if I hadn't taken him there, he might not have made it (the other vet said so). They had to put in four external and three internal stitches to reconstruct his triceps. Once the surgery was over and he was out of danger, they told me there wasn't an antibiotic that lasted 48 hours and that they should have prescribed antibiotic pills. I contacted the director to explain everything and request reimbursement, since if things had been done correctly from the beginning, there wouldn't have been any need to take him to the emergency room. They told me to come on a Monday, and after many calls and being given the runaround, I finally went there on Thursday. The director laughed in my face at the other vet's recommendations, claiming she had more experience.
I DO NOT RECOMMEND EITHER THEIR CLINIC OR THEIR DOG KENNEL (we were greeted at the door by a potentially dangerous breed that immediately attacked my greyhound upon arrival).
terrible

🚨These miserable people have teamed up with Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas Airport ❌ Their greed is obvious!!
For context: I was traveling from Colombia to Spain with my service dog in the cargo hold, as I don't like to inconvenience anyone in the cabin because he's a large dog.
- The dog had all his documents in order - but unfortunately, we encountered the most xenophobic officer of all, and the chip failed, something that almost never fails. 😞 Something that's very difficult to control, this officer refused to let the dog through and practically accused us of having all the documents forged, when clearly in Colombia there are strict controls, and it's also impossible to board without the documentation.
They didn't offer us any solution, and in the end, after much arguing for our pet, we desperately wanted to bring the dog into Spain, but surprise, surprise, the quarantine fee from these people amounted to €4,944.86, insane!
I hope they never have to deal with what we went through, you wretches! And I'm leaving this photo so everyone can see how despicable they are, charging so much just because something goes wrong. They make it almost impossible just to get the pet in. Conde Orgaz Veterinary Hospital. Thank you for being so inhumane.

In the end, even though we wanted to pay, they gave the dog an expulsion order. 😞

I took my dog ​​in for indigestion. They did blood work and a complete blood count and told me she was intoxicated. They gave me four different medications, which my dog ​​refused to take, and the poor thing still wouldn't eat or sleep because they weren't addressing her problem. They told me I could admit her, which I refused, and they still charged me a fortune. They also talked about spaying and the whole package. It was all sales pitches, and the service left much to be desired.
Today I took her to her regular vet. The vet examined her, gave her an injection, we waited two hours, and now she's back to her old self, eating and sleeping. I will never take her back to that clinic.
Excellent service! Marta helped me get my kitten out of customs quickly after a problem with her microchip. Thank you 🙏🏼 …
Excellent service. Highly recommended.
Good service and professionalism
Kindness and professionalism as our hallmarks. A top-notch service. It's been a pleasure these past six years with you.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for four years, and after several vets, we're both delighted. The service is wonderful, and the care they show us is fantastic. Almudena is one of the best professionals; the way she treats my dog ​​is unbeatable. She always makes sure I understand everything and that my dog ​​is as comfortable as possible. Highly recommended.

We lost our dog after a terrible experience at this clinic. We went there for an emergency, and they returned our companion to us in worse condition than when he arrived.
We felt a lack of empathy, ethics, and humanity. We hope no one else has to go through the same thing.

Wonderful veterinary hospital; they saved our furry friend's life a few years ago after he suffered poisoning. The treatment is wonderful every time we go; we will always be grateful. Highly recommended.

I took my dog ​​in when he was six months old, desperate because he was covered in sores and rashes due to his allergies, and no one was offering me any solutions. Thanks to Irene and the whole team, they treated my dog, and today he's doing wonderfully. They saved his life, and he lives a normal life despite all his allergies. I also have another dog who was terrified of the vet and had to be dragged in. Now she goes in happily thanks to the care and dedication they give her. They're a great team and very professional. I've been going to them for over four years, and I'll definitely be staying with them.

Delighted. I took my cat in after she'd been vomiting and had skin lesions for five years due to an allergy she hadn't been tested for because it was difficult to know what cats could be allergic to. Irene saw her, and from the first appointment, she knew it was a food allergy. We stopped all the medication and started treating her with natural fungi in her food, and my cat couldn't be better. Thank you, Irene, for everything and for being so attentive to Shia's progress!

We've been going to this veterinary hospital for seven years and have never had a single complaint. They are caring, attentive, and highly professional, having lovingly cared for Seal, Noa, Nala, and Nube, and now doing the same for Trufa and Lola. Over these years, we've faced various tumors, neurological diseases, and mobility issues, all of which they have diagnosed and treated with remarkable efficiency. They have state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment and a physiotherapy and rehabilitation service that enabled Nala to walk again after polyradiculitis left her quadriplegic. We are thrilled, and so are our furry friends!
Irene's service was impeccable. I took my cat in for a dermatological problem and she diagnosed it in ten minutes. Super friendly and attentive, a 10 out of 10!
They're very competent and the place is lovely. Our cat doesn't like everything, but we do! Haha

Hello. I'm Paloma Vigara Ramos, and I'm replying from this account to your response to my review. Let me tell you a few things: the first thing I said in my review is that this happened years ago, and I mentioned that you caught me off guard because, not wanting to harm you and because I was feeling down and upset, I didn't write a review at the time (not for lack of wanting to). I say you caught me off guard now because for the last four years you've had the nerve—to put it mildly—to keep sending me emails every other day saying you have news for me. This time, I'm the one giving you the news: I DO NOT INTEND TO WITHDRAW THIS REVIEW, make no mistake about it. I would consider it, and perhaps I would do it if you had been humble enough to admit the huge mistake you made with me, but far from admitting it, you still have the nerve to tell me that you're only replying because you lost a colleague to people like me. My dog, unfortunately, would have died anyway even if you had known what was wrong with her. It's outrageous that after a week of going to your clinic practically every day, you never figured out what was wrong. By the way, if you read my review carefully (which you apparently can't do either), I never said the dog was hospitalized for seven days. I said she was there for three days, which is what she was. Anyway, when you sue me, remember to bring the videos and photos you claim you sent me during that hospitalization, because I certainly never received them. You returned my dog ​​to me, and I remember perfectly the name of the person who gave her back to me (although I won't say it), telling me: "The dog has no symptoms, it's just her age, give her this medication and this food." This was on a Sunday afternoon. On Tuesday, I had to rush to another clinic at six in the morning, and on Wednesday, I had to put my dog ​​down because she was so sick. I asked you to send me the test results you had done on my dog, and I had to call you twice because they hadn't arrived. The excuse you gave me for not sending them from the beginning was: "Oh, when you called to request them, there wasn't a vet available." Unbelievable! A clinic that was supposed to be 24 hours a day, and there wasn't a vet available when I called. And anyway, those tests should have been in my dog's file/record, I imagine. I think anyone with access to a computer could have sent them. But no, you didn't do that right away either. I had to insist. And I'm not saying that if you had known what was wrong with the dog, she would have been saved. I'm just saying that after eight days (from Saturday to the following Sunday) you still didn't know what was wrong with her. Tests and dirty tricks, yes, DAMN TRICKS, plenty, but not a single ultrasound. By the way, you also accused me of owing money when it was one of you who made a mistake in the calculations. I HAVE NEVER IN MY LIFE OWED ANYONE MONEY. And the day I went to talk to you to tell you that my dog ​​was dead because of a lymphoma you failed to detect, you greeted me with… “YOU OWED MONEY…” How tactless and how little empathy, but above all, and most importantly: WHAT A HUGE LIE. By the way, if you think my review is irrelevant, why do you want me to remove it? I repeat: I AM NOT GOING TO REMOVE THIS REVIEW. You want to sue me? Here I am. Tell me where I have to go and at what time. I AM NOT AFRAID TO TESTIFY WHEREVER I HAVE TO GO. EVERYTHING I'VE SAID IS TRUE, AND I'LL SAY IT IN FRONT OF WHOEVER NEEDS TO BE PRESENT. And I'm going to say it loud and clear: FOUR YEARS AGO, AFTER EIGHT DAYS AND 1200 EUROS, YOU DIDN'T KNOW THAT MY DOG WAS BEING EATEN UP FROM THE INSIDE BY LYMPHOMA. And now you go and sue me. I'll be waiting for you. I really don't care. And you know why? Because what I truly cared about, I've already lost.

I took my dog ​​to this clinic and couldn't be more grateful for the care we received. From the very first moment, the staff was kind, patient, and very professional.
My dog ​​is somewhat nervous and fearful in unfamiliar surroundings, but they treated her with such love and care that she felt safe almost immediately.

The vets took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and gave me very helpful recommendations for her recovery. It's clear they love animals and prioritize the well-being of each patient. I will definitely return whenever I need to; I'm very happy!

I heard about this hospital, tried it, and I don't regret it at all. The service was exemplary, the staff very professional and friendly to both the clients and the animals. Without a doubt, an excellent choice.
A very good experience, with a very friendly and professional approach. Their love for animals is evident.

Terrible professionals. I never usually write reviews, and this happened a while ago, but today I felt like it. I took my dog ​​in years ago for bloody diarrhea. They prescribed pills after an x-ray, but they didn't help at all. I went back two or three days later, and they did blood work, which showed liver failure, and they kept her hospitalized for three days. After those three days, during which they did all sorts of unnecessary things to her (and didn't even do an ultrasound, which was the test she really needed), they sent my dog ​​back to me saying she had no symptoms and that what was happening was due to her age (she had just turned nine). They charged me a total of 1200 euros. As soon as we left, my dog ​​had another bloody, loose bowel movement. I took her home, and a day and a half later, the dog was in terrible shape. She had a vacant stare, wasn't eating (anyone who has Labradors knows that a Labrador that doesn't eat is a bad sign), and was vomiting constantly. I took her to another emergency clinic where she arrived in very bad condition. She was hospitalized for a day, they stabilized her, and they did an ultrasound which revealed she had very advanced lymphoma affecting many internal organs. After a week and 1200 euros, this clinic still didn't know what was wrong with my dog. They were very friendly to be around but very unprofessional. They had no idea what they were doing. Expensive and money-grubbing. I never went back.
I visited the center today and was delighted with the service and professionalism! If you're looking for a place you can trust with your pet's diagnosis, don't hesitate to go. 100% recommended!
This is a wonderful hospital; they treated my dog ​​beautifully, and I feel completely safe there. I wouldn't trust any other place with my pet's well-being.

We've known this veterinary hospital for a long time and have always received exceptional service. They are highly professional and we have complete confidence in them, so I recommend them without hesitation.
We went with our dog and they treated us wonderfully! Thank you so much for your professionalism!

This is the best veterinary hospital I've ever taken my dog ​​to.
The service is impeccable, the attention is personalized, they have many resources to handle difficult situations (like mine), and they treat dogs with the same care as if they were their own.
I have nothing but praise for them.
Thank you!
They are excellent professionals, lovely, and incredibly caring with animals. My dog ​​is thrilled every time we go. And they make things very easy.

I've been going to them for many years, and they get better every day. They're incredibly professional, always up-to-date on the latest techniques, and everything else. They offer a peace of mind and security that makes any procedure much easier. My two dogs go absolutely thrilled when they go to the vet! There are no better vets!

Gru is happy. The treatment we've received has always been incredible.
Most importantly, whenever we need something for Gru, they're there and take care of him as soon as we contact the clinic. They are unbeatable, both personally and professionally.

I've been taking my dog ​​Gus to Orgaz Veterinary Hospital since 2018. The care and professionalism are outstanding. They are incredibly caring with both the dogs and their owners, always reassuring and supportive. Highly recommended!
Both the personal and professional service were excellent, thank you very much.
Great professionals, with an endless love for animals. 100% recommended.
My dog ​​left very happy. Your service is kind and caring, yet very professional. It's wonderful to find a pleasant atmosphere when you need care for your pets.
For their professionalism and the seriousness with which they treat our pets, I recommend entrusting your pets to them. Keep up the good work!

Conde Orgaz Hospital is by far the best I've ever been to. It has a summer campsite, and the facilities are incredibly comprehensive, offering all kinds of tests for our furry friends. They are very friendly and caring towards both us and our pets. 100% recommended.

The first time I went to this vet was for an emergency with my dear old Rukia, a wonderful Labrador who was having a lot of mobility problems due to her age. She had a very nasty wound on her ankle, and the care she received was so good, and I was so satisfied, that even though he's not nearby since I live in a different neighborhood, he's immediately become my regular and trusted vet.

Excellent treatment; Floky felt right at home. Whenever I've taken him to a vet, he's always been scared. Here it was different from the very first moment. Plus, the CEOs welcomed him like one of their own.
Great service and even better attention for Roco, the best choice of all I know.

We called for a veterinary emergency on Tuesday, February 11th at 3:30 AM and no one answered the phone or even bothered to return our call. It's not a 24-hour service, and if it is, it's clearly not.

Edit: Of course, I'm not going to delete my review. If you're not a 24-hour hospital, the first thing you need to do is update your services and remove the photos you yourselves posted that clearly say "24 HOURS." I hope this review doesn't confuse anyone and that they choose another center that demonstrates the professionalism your clinic lacks. It's unbelievable that you work in animal health and lie about the services you offer, with the risk that someone in need of urgent care might go to your clinic and find it closed.

A few days ago, I took my dog ​​to the clinic in a very worrying state. He was in a lot of pain, disoriented, and drooling constantly. I was terrified because I'm not from Madrid and couldn't go to his usual vet, and I had no idea what could be wrong. I decided to take him to this clinic, and they acted quickly and efficiently. They treated us with great care and gave us an immediate diagnosis. I felt so relieved seeing all the resources they have and that they have truly dedicated professionals working there. You can tell right away. The care they gave Tango was incredible. They sent me photos while he was hospitalized, which was incredibly reassuring, and once he was stable with the medication they prescribed, he recovered very quickly. It's a top-notch clinic with top-notch staff. If you want a clinic/hospital with all the resources... don't hesitate. People who love their animals want the best. Almudena, who treated us, is the kind of veterinarian we all dream of finding, with a genuine passion for her work. THANK YOU
They advertise themselves as a center with 24-hour in-person emergency services, and that's a lie.

Perfect hospital! I took Pipo (my cat) in because of a mass on his spleen. They were quick and very efficient, attending to him and performing an abdominal ultrasound. Thank you so much for your hard work!
Fantastic clinic, the staff are very friendly and treat pets with great respect and affection.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet, and it wasn't until an hour later that my boyfriend arrived and kindly suggested the specific blood test he needed. The "doctor" did it, I went home, and five minutes later she called to say he'd died…

I went to have some tests done on my dog, who was very ill, and in the end, I had to have him euthanized. They were incredibly kind and understanding. They gave me advice and helped me with everything. I highly recommend them. They were …

The first time we went, we went without an appointment, scared because our 2-month-old puppy had bloody stools. Irene treated us without any problems, calmed us down, and immediately provided an effective remedy. She's very friendly, very …

My kitten, who was only a few months old, had her first heat and ran away from home. When I found her, the first thing I did was call the clinic and explain that I wanted to spay her, but that there was a possibility she was pregnant, and I …

Lovely and highly professional veterinarians, unparalleled service. The hospital has a 12/7/365 emergency service, which is incredibly convenient as there's no other vet in the area.
100% my trusted veterinarian in Madrid 👌 …
